patterns.name: Unchecked Authority/Signer
patterns.description: Instruction handler does not verify the signer authority, allowing anyone to call admin functions
patterns.recommendation: Add has_one or signer constraints to verify the caller is authorized

patterns.name: Unrestricted Mint Authority
patterns.description: Token mint instruction without proper authority checks — anyone could mint tokens
patterns.recommendation: Ensure mint authority is properly constrained and verified

patterns.name: Hidden Admin Withdrawal
patterns.description: Function allows draining SOL/tokens from program-owned accounts to admin
patterns.recommendation: Ensure withdrawal functions are properly gated and amounts are limited

patterns.name: Freeze Authority Retained
patterns.description: Program retains freeze authority over user token accounts
patterns.recommendation: Revoke freeze authority after initialization, or document clearly why it's needed

patterns.name: Mutable Program State Without Timelock
patterns.description: Critical program parameters can be changed by admin immediately
patterns.recommendation: Add a timelock mechanism for parameter changes

patterns.name: Arbitrary CPI (Cross-Program Invocation)
patterns.description: CPI to a program ID stored in a mutable account — attacker could swap the target program
patterns.recommendation: Hardcode program IDs or verify them against known constants

patterns.name: Unsafe Deserialization
patterns.description: Deserializing account data without verifying the account owner — type confusion attack
patterns.recommendation: Always verify account.owner matches expected program ID before deserializing

patterns.name: Unchecked PDA Derivation
patterns.description: PDA seeds are user-controlled without proper validation — allows account substitution
patterns.recommendation: Validate PDA derivation with bump constraints in Anchor

patterns.name: Unsafe Transmute/Cast
patterns.description: Using unsafe to transmute or cast data types — can bypass type safety and hide malicious operations
patterns.recommendation: Avoid unsafe blocks. If needed, document thoroughly and audit carefully

patterns.name: Hidden Instruction in Init
patterns.description: Initialization function performs unexpected actions like transferring tokens
patterns.recommendation: Init functions should only set up state. Move all transfers to explicit functions

patterns.name: Upgradeable Program Without Constraints
patterns.description: Program is upgradeable and authority is a single keypair
patterns.recommendation: Use multi-sig for upgrade authority. Consider making program immutable after audit

patterns.name: Integer Overflow/Underflow
patterns.description: Arithmetic without overflow checks in critical calculations
patterns.recommendation: Use checked arithmetic (checked_add, checked_sub, etc.) for all financial calculations

patterns.name: Missing Account Validation
patterns.description: Account constraints are missing — program accepts accounts it shouldn't
patterns.recommendation: Use typed accounts with proper constraints instead of raw AccountInfo

patterns.name: Insufficient Signer Check
patterns.description: Function accepts a signer but doesn't verify it matches the expected authority
patterns.recommendation: Add key constraints to verify the signer is the expected authority

patterns.name: Duplicate Mutable Account
patterns.description: Same account passed as two different mutable arguments — can cause unexpected behavior
patterns.recommendation: Add constraint to ensure mutable accounts are distinct

patterns.name: Panicking in Production
patterns.description: Using unwrap() or expect() instead of proper error handling
patterns.recommendation: Use proper error handling with Result types and custom error enums
